missing_pieces.duty: MP-0 / ED26-P15-CH-feller-bernstein-hausdorff-C020: def:p15-feller-moment-scope (handbook/parts/p15/feller-bernstein-hausdorff.tex lines 430--434) keeps the original Hausdorff and Heyde papers as separate source variants. Each is owed as its own presentation, with definitions, hypotheses, construction or argument, and worked boundary. None of these sources is held: there is no entry in held-sources.json, no file under source/references and no bib record. The works are F. Hausdorff, 'Summationsmethoden und Momentfolgen I/II', Math. Z. 9 (1921) pp. 74--109, 280--299; F. Hausdorff, 'Momentprobleme fuer ein endliches Intervall', Math. Z. 16 (1923) pp. 220--248; and C. C. Heyde, 'On a property of the lognormal distribution', J. Roy. Statist. Soc. B 25 (1963) pp. 392--393. These are the original journal versions; the bibliographic details could not be checked because no copy is held. The later Feller transform and analytic-proof variants (VII.5--VII.6, XIII.1, XV.2--XV.4, X.8--X.9, XIII.9--XIII.10) are covered by the routed owned files (body lines 1--1275, annex lines 1--1640).
